name: rename-koalaconfig-type-to-latticeconfig
title: Rename the KoalaConfig type to LatticeConfig (open-source ship-clean code identifier)
description: Rename the project-config TypeScript interface KoalaConfig to LatticeConfig across its definition and all consumers. It is the only Koala* PascalCase code identifier left in the codebase (5 files, ~20 occurrences) and is a user-facing API surface (the return type of loadConfig()). Pure mechanical identifier rename, no behavior change. A bounded slice of the broader koala residual-sweep program; other residual cleanup (config sample fixtures, code comments, documentation wording, the lab config reader) is handled in later slices.
